The '''Iokath Civil War''' was a centuries-long conflict that took place on [[Iokath]] at some point during the [[Manderon Period]].

==History==
[[Unidentified Iokath species|The species that constructed]] [[Iokath]], a massive sphere completely surrounding its [[Iokath system's star|star]], was composed of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and [[Engineer/Legends|engineers]], who created weapons of mass destruction and perfected them through testing on unsuspecting worlds throughout [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]].<ref name="KOTET 4">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=4}}</ref> One of their greatest weapons was known as the [[Six Gods]] - massive titan [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] designated [[Izax]], [[Scyva]], [[Tyth]], [[Aivela]], [[Esne]], and [[Nahut]] - and was tested on four different planets, resulting in loss of over ten trillion lives in total.<ref name="Six">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|The Six Gods}}</ref> Eventually, as typical for organic beings, a dispute erupted on Iokath when an act of sabotage ignited the pressurized gas in the pneumatic tram system and sparked a catastrophic explosion that killed thousands and leveled a nearby settlement.
[[File:Izax_in_flight.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Izax, chief of the gods who brought an end to the Iokath civlization.]]
This attack sparked the Iokath Civil War that lasted for centuries<ref name="Trams">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|Pneumatic Trams}}</ref> with both sides having access to multiple [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapons]] of mass destruction. In an attempt to save themselves, Iokath engineers drove many of their creations, including the [[Eternal Fleet]], the [[GEMINI]] droids and [[SCORPIO]] [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]] into the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]] with their [[Memory bank/Legends|memory cores]] locked, preventing them from finding their way back to Iokath.<ref name="KOTET 4" /> However, this proved only a temporary solution, as the Six Gods were eventually unleashed on Iokath, leading to eradication of all organic life on the world.<ref name="Six" /> In the aftermath of the conflict, only one self-aware [[Droid/Legends|droid]] remained on Iokath - [[ARIES]], who used other droids as slaves to remake the world in his image.<ref name="ARIES">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=codex|ARIES}}</ref>
